title: Level up the member
prompt: Members `level` at 1 and `max_health` at 100. A level-up makes the robot one level higher and doubles its maximum health, through a `level_up` helper. max_health_after_level levels up once and reports 200.
starter:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func max_health_after_level():
	return max_health
hints: level_up adds 1 to level and multiplies max_health by 2; max_health_after_level calls it once and returns max_health.
`*=` multiplies a variable in place, like += adds.

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func max_health_after_level():
	level_up()
	return max_health

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2
